# Dissolve

Burns the surface away as `progress` goes from 0 to 1, in noisy patches or as a front sweeping up the object, with a glowing edge. Animate `progress` to reveal or remove objects.

<EffectDemo effect="dissolve" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { dissolve } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/dissolve';

const effect = dissolve({ preset: 'embers' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.progress = 0.45`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                                                      | Default     | Range    | Description                                                                  |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `progress`      | number                                                    | `0.45`      | 0 – 1    | How much has dissolved: 0 is whole, 1 is gone.                               |
| `pattern`       | 'noise' \| 'sweep'                                        | `'noise'`   |          | Dissolve in noisy patches, or as a front moving up through the height range. |
| `range`         | [x, y]                                                    | `[0, 2.5]`  | -50 – 50 | Sweep: world heights where the front starts and ends.                        |
| `noiseScale`    | number                                                    | `2.5`       | 0.1 – 20 | Size of the noise patches: higher is finer.                                  |
| `noiseAmount`   | number                                                    | `0.25`      | 0 – 1    | Sweep: how ragged the front is.                                              |
| `edgeWidth`     | number                                                    | `0.06`      | 0 – 0.3  | Width of the glowing edge, in units of progress.                             |
| `edgeColor`     | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#ff8a3d'` |          | Color of the burning edge.                                                   |
| `edgeIntensity` | number                                                    | `4`         | 0 – 20   | Brightness of the edge, in linear units (above 1 blooms with HDR effects).   |
| `seed`          | integer                                                   | `0`         | 0 – 9999 | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames.      |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                                                       |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `embers`  | `edgeColor: '#ff5a1f'`, `edgeIntensity: 6`, `noiseScale: 3.5`                  |
| `digital` | `edgeColor: '#4cc9ff'`, `edgeWidth: 0.03`, `noiseScale: 8`, `edgeIntensity: 5` |
| `sweep`   | `pattern: 'sweep'`, `progress: 0.5`, `noiseAmount: 0.3`                        |
| `ash`     | `edgeColor: '#9a8f86'`, `edgeIntensity: 0.6`, `edgeWidth: 0.12`                |

Apply one with `dissolve({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 8.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/dissolve`, including the shared effect runtime.
